subject: Account re-up: capacity runway, term options & QBR timebox
messages:
From: Riley Sun <riley@ellipsishealth.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@ellipsishealth.ai
Date: 2026-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal kickoff: Redwood re-up & capacity runway

Sergio —

As we approach our August 31 contract renewal, I wanted to kick off planning on the Ellipsis side for capacity increases and term options. We’ve seen a ~45% increase in inference volume the last two months (attached usage extract) and want to make sure the renewal covers predictable runway + a scalable uplift path.

High-level asks from us:
- Quick readout from Redwood on current utilization vs committed throughput
- Options for a 12 vs 24 month term (including any uplift pricing)
- A simple mutual action plan (who owns what, deadlines)
- SOC 2 + audit evidence to pass to procurement (we’ll need it soon)

Can we schedule a short QBR/renewal session to align stakeholders? Week of July 6 looks promising for our leadership — ideally a 45–60 minute slot to review usage, options, and a proposed timeline.

I’m copying procurement here; Sam Park (cc’d) will join for capacity planning. I’d appreciate a proposed timeline and owners from your side.

Thanks,
Riley
Head of Platform
Ellipsis Health

Attachment: Ellipsis_usage_report_Q1-Q2.csv (csv)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Riley Sun <riley@ellipsishealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: Redwood re-up & capacity runway

Riley — thanks for the heads up and for sending the usage extract. Diving in now; high level we can support a few paths depending how long you want to lock pricing and whether you want burst capacity for seasonal peaks.

Proposed next steps (from Redwood):
1) Internal review (today–Jun 18): Marissa to map your reported consumption to current commit and burst utilization.
2) Options doc (Jun 19): Ben to circulate 3 pricing/term options (12m, 24m, 24m+reserved burst) with delta on unit token cost and GPU footprint.
3) Legal & procurement checklist (Jun 22): Laura to surface any standard amendment items and SOC2 artifacts.
4) QBR/renewal alignment (week of Jul 6): 45–60 min slot to finalize mutual action plan and get verbal alignment.

Tentative owners:
- CSM/Onboarding & success: Marissa Cole (I’ll loop her for usage reconciliation)
- Pricing & commercial: Ben Carter
- Contracts & legal: Laura Bennett
- Renewal lead & exec sponsor: me (Sergio)

I created a short Doodle for the July 6–9 window: https://doodle.com/poll/abcd-ellis-qbr-availability — can you and Sam indicate availability? We’ll convert to a calendar invite once you confirm.

Attachment: Redwood-renewal-options-v2.pdf (pdf) — this is a draft template I’ll share; Ben will update numbers after the usage match.

Preliminary ask for your procurement team: which billing/legal contact should Laura work with? We’ll include a draft amendment and a mutual action plan alongside the options doc.

Best,
Sergio
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Riley Sun <riley@ellipsishealth.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Park <sam.park@ellipsishealth.ai>, procurement@ellipsishealth.ai
Date: 2026-06-16T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: Redwood re-up & capacity runway

Thanks, Sergio — this looks good. I and Sam confirmed availability on the Doodle for Jul 7 (afternoon PT) and Jul 8 (morning PT). Procurement will be led by our Counsel, Mei Tan (me.emailing procurement for contact) — I’ll put her on the thread as soon as I have the direct line.

A few clarifications from our side:
- We’re targeting a 24-month commitment if the uplift pricing is <10% and burst is available at a capped surcharge.
- We need SOC 2 Type II (most recent) and the associated control narrative by Jun 22 to pass to security.
- Can you include an explicit runway for additional GPU hours (monthly cap + overage rate) in the options doc? Our infra team wants predictability for spike events.

If you can get the options doc and a short mutual action plan over by Jun 19, we’ll be in a good place to drive procurement review and get the legal redline started.

Riley

>

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-06-18T15:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: Redwood re-up & capacity runway

Great — appreciate the quick turn. We’ll action the June milestones and aim to have the following to you by end-of-day Jun 19:
- Finalized options doc (Ben): 12m / 24m / 24m+burst with explicit monthly GPU hour caps and overage SLOs.
- Draft mutual action plan (attached): owners, deadlines, deliverables.
- SOC2 evidence packet (Laura): pointer to the audit summary and control attachments for procurement.

High level mutual action plan (excerpt):
- Jun 15–19: Usage reconciliation (Marissa) — confirm committed tokens vs observed.
- Jun 19–22: Options & draft amendment (Ben & Laura) — commercial terms and draft legal language.
- Jun 23–Jul 2: Procurement review / legal redlines (Ellipsis procurement + Redwood legal).
- Jul 6–9: Renewal QBR (45–60 min) — final align and signoff on term and uplift.
- Jul 15–31: Execute amendment and provisioning for uplift (ops + customer onboarding).

Action items for Ellipsis: confirm procurement contact (Mei/Procurement), indicate preferred QBR date (we’ve got Jul 7 afternoon PT and Jul 8 morning PT indicated), and confirm target uplift % that will trigger capacity provisioning.

I’m attaching a draft MutualActionPlan_ellipsis_v1.docx — it’s intentionally lean and assigns owners and target dates so procurement has a clear checklist. Once you confirm the QBR date we’ll send a calendar invite with the draft deck.

If it helps, I’ll loop in our Solutions Architect to run a short deep-dive on any technical usage discrepancies before the QBR (Marissa will coordinate).

Thanks — talk soon.

Sergio
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MutualActionPlan_ellipsis_v1.docx (docx)
